_note: Dynamic universe count gate (P1a, 2026-10-30). Replaces the hard 400-440 band. Expected = the previously published universe count (origin/main), because no free NEPSE-official listed-securities endpoint exists in this pipeline (the builder's listing sources are the community companies list + live feed; paid/licensed MDP endpoints are out of scope). Allowed deviation = max(tolerance_symbols, ceil(expected * tolerance_pct)). The added/dropped symbol diff vs origin/main is always printed (change-vs-previous-run alert); a swing beyond tolerance fails the run.
